hypotheses.hypothesis: Injecting 500ms network delay on service/front-end will cause the front-end home page to exceed the 15s timeout, violating the non-empty HTML contract.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: front-end is the entry point for all golden journey steps; delay directly impacts response time.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: front-end home returns non-empty HTML within 15s
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject network_delay on service/front-end, then execute front-end home step and measure response time and status.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: Removing the delay restores normal response times and contract compliance.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Injecting 500ms network delay on service/catalogue will cause the catalogue browse step to fail or timeout, violating the JSON array contract.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: catalogue is a critical dependency for the catalogue browse step; delay increases latency beyond acceptable limits.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: catalogue browse returns JSON array within 15s
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject network_delay on service/catalogue, then execute catalogue step and check response.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: Removing the delay restores catalogue browse to normal.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Injecting 500ms network delay on service/user will cause the login step to fail or timeout, violating the Cookie is set contract.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: user service is required for authentication; delay impacts login response time.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: login returns HTTP 200 and sets a cookie within 15s
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject network_delay on service/user, then execute login step and check status and cookie.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: Removing the delay restores login functionality.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Injecting 500ms network delay on service/orders will cause the authenticated orders step to fail or timeout, violating the JSON array or object contract.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: orders service is required for the orders step; delay impacts response time.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: authenticated orders returns HTTP 201 with JSON within 15s
hypotheses.validation_plan: Inject network_delay on service/orders, then execute orders step and check status and body.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: Removing the delay restores orders step to normal.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Killing the front-end pod will cause all golden journey steps to fail because the front-end service has no healthy endpoints.
hypotheses.weakness_surface: front-end is the single entry point; pod kill removes the only replica.
hypotheses.expected_invariant: front-end service is available and returns HTTP 200 for all steps
hypotheses.validation_plan: Kill the front-end pod, then execute all golden journey steps and check for failures.
hypotheses.recovery_expectation: The pod will be restarted by the deployment controller, restoring service.
